name: DropGaussian
definition: A regularization technique for sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting that randomly removes Gaussians during the training process to alleviate overfitting to training views.
summary: DropGaussian is a prior-free structural regularization technique that mitigates overfitting in 3D Gaussian Splatting by randomly dropping Gaussians during training while scaling remaining opacities to preserve color contribution.
